title: High Grade Appendix Cancer Thriver
content: High Grade Appendix Cancer ThriverRadical Remission ProjectFeb 5, 20252 min readElizabeth Ames is an attorney, wife, and mom of 2 rambunctious boys. She was diagnosed with appendix cancer at 38 years old and, from the outside looking in, she was the picture of health. Elizabeth was an athlete who loved working out and eating healthy, and even previously owned a crossfit gym. She has always been an "avid life consumer" and being diagnosed with cancer only tripled that passion and will to live. Upon diagnosis, Elizabeth read every book she could get her hands on, listened to every podcast, and talked to every mentor and expert she could find. She continued to work out every day and even ran the Winship 5k the day after her 6th round of chemo and one month before her MOAS - Mother of All Surgeries.
